name: Bromperidol
summary: Bromperidol, sold under the brand names Bromidol and Impromen among others, is a typical antipsychotic of the butyrophenone group which is used in the treatment of schizophrenia. It was discovered at Janssen Pharmaceutica in 1966. An ester prodrug, bromperidol decanoate, is a long-acting form of bromperidol used as a depot injectable.

pharmacology.text: An ester prodrug, bromperidol decanoate, is a long-acting form of bromperidol used as a depot injectable.

uses.text: Bromperidol, sold under the brand names Bromidol and Impromen among others, is a typical antipsychotic of the butyrophenone group which is used in the treatment of schizophrenia. An ester prodrug, bromperidol decanoate, is a long-acting form of bromperidol used as a depot injectable.

sideEffects.en: As a potent dopamine blocker it commonly causes stiffness, tremor, restlessness, sedation and raised prolactin. Long-term use risks tardive dyskinesia, lasting involuntary movements.
sideEffects.zh: 作為強效多巴胺阻斷劑，它常造成肌肉僵硬、顫抖、坐立不安、鎮靜與泌乳素升高。長期使用有遲發性運動障礙的風險，即持續的不自主動作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 作为强效多巴胺阻断剂，它常造成肌肉僵硬、颤抖、坐立不安、镇静与泌乳素升高。长期使用有迟发性运动障碍的风险，即持续的不自主动作。

fact.en: It is haloperidol with bromine in place of chlorine, and it was discovered at the same Janssen laboratory. Bromine and chlorine are neighbours in the periodic table, so the two drugs behave very similarly.
fact.zh: 它是把氟哌啶醇的氯換成溴的產物，並在同一間楊森實驗室被發現。溴與氯在週期表中相鄰，因此這兩種藥物的作用非常相似。
fact.zhHans: 它是把氟哌啶醇的氯换成溴的产物，并在同一间杨森实验室被发现。溴与氯在周期表中相邻，因此这两种药物的作用非常相似。
